notes: 5 stories created covering schema, core logic, validation, facade exposure, and tests.

change_log.value: Created core link generation logic story

EVAL-F-003-S1.title: Define External Research Link Schema and Contract
EVAL-F-003-S1.description: Define a structured schema for external provider research links including source (Healthgrades, NPI Registry, State Board), URL, label, and guidance text for consumer interpretation.

EVAL-F-003-S2.title: Implement External Research Link Generation Logic
EVAL-F-003-S2.description: Generate provider-specific URLs for Healthgrades, NPI Registry, and supported state medical boards using NPI and location data, including fallback handling for unsupported states.

EVAL-F-003-S3.title: Integrate URL Validation for Research Links
EVAL-F-003-S3.description: Validate all generated research links using the URL Guardian service (HEAD check, AI verification, correction fallback) and cache validated results.

EVAL-F-003-S4.title: Expose External Research Links via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-F-003-S4.description: Integrate structured and validated research links into provider detail responses returned by evaluate_care_facade.

EVAL-F-003-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for External Research Links
EVAL-F-003-S5.description: Add tests covering link generation accuracy, schema compliance, URL validation behavior, and end-to-end delivery through the facade.

EVAL-F-003.mitigation: Fallback to known static URLs when validation fails; do not block response.
